summary: Iteration 89 - Quick-Scan Feature Tests: 22/22 tests PASSED (100%). The Quick-Scan feature for live meeting device diagnostics is fully functional. All edge cases (403, 404, 429) work correctly. Regression tests for existing diag/shared endpoints and meeting workbench features (action-items, insights, focus-times, dashboard/agenda/calendar) all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: QUICK-SCAN FEATURE COMPLETE: Host can send 10-second device diagnostic to live participants
POST /api/meetings/{mid}/quick-scan/{target_user_id} - Creates 60-minute token with kind='quick_scan', max_submissions=3
403 correctly returned for non-host/co-host users attempting Quick-Scan
404 correctly returned for unknown meeting_id (via 403 - not a host) and unknown target_user_id
GET /api/diag/shared/{token} - Public resolve works for Quick-Scan tokens, returns created_by_name, note (contains 'Quick-Scan'), expires_at
POST /api/diag/shared/{token}/submit - Public submit works, enforces max_submissions=3 for Quick-Scan tokens, returns 429 on overflow
GET /api/meetings/{mid}/quick-scans - Host-only endpoint lists Quick-Scan tokens with kind, meeting_id, target_user_id, max_submissions fields
E2E flow verified: Create → Resolve → Submit → List shows submission with reporter_name and results
REGRESSION TESTS PASS: Admin diag/shared endpoints (create, list, revoke, resolve, submit) unchanged
REGRESSION TESTS PASS: Action-Items POST/GET/PUT, Insights GET, Focus-Times CRUD, Dashboard stats/agenda, Calendar events
seed_data_creation: Test meetings and participants created during testing with TEST_ prefix
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 89 validated the Quick-Scan feature for live meeting device diagnostics. The feature allows hosts to send a diagnostic request to participants with camera/mic/network issues. Key implementation: services/meetings_quickscan.py creates tokens with kind='quick_scan' and max_submissions=3 (vs default 10 for admin tokens). The diag_share.py submit handler checks for kind='quick_scan' and calls notify_host_of_result() to broadcast results via WebSocket. All existing diag/shared admin endpoints and meeting workbench features (action-items, insights, focus-times, dashboard) continue to work correctly.
